findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_auction" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read one car auction's current public bid state; search_auctions discovers events and get_vehicle provides the linked car's facts. - auction_id binds every bid …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_parts, search_vehicles · Private data: get_part, get_vehicle, get_auction, search_auctions · Public sink: get_part, prepare_vehicle_handoff, prepare_part_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_parts, search_vehicles · Private data: get_part, get_vehicle, get_auction, search_auctions · Public sink: get_part, prepare_vehicle_handoff, prepare_part_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
